title: Incredible Nonstick Surface Makes Cooked Food Hard to Remove
text:
Incredible Nonstick Surface Makes Cooked Food Hard to Remove. These two COOKING LIGHT ALLURE PREMIER CERAMIC NON-STICK COATING SKILLETS (8 inch and 9.5 inch Skillet Set, Stay Cool Handle, Easy Clean, Red) are gorgeous. The outer finish is a deep red lacquer.

The skillets have a nonstick surface that is incredible. Unfortunately, the nonstick surface is so good, it’s hard to remove your food (e.g., fried eggs). The cooked food just slides across the skillet surface as you try to get a spatula or turner under it.

Also, the skillets don’t conduct heat very well. They take a long time to warm up. The instructions say that for best results you should preheat the skillets for 2-3 minutes on low heat. That is good advice to follow.

The “stay cool” handles heat up somewhat. The handles have red silicon wrapped around them, but you can feel the heat through the silicon. Usually you won’t need a hotpad, though.

The two skillets come in convenient sizes. The smaller skillet is 8” across; the larger skillet is 9.5” across. The skillets are “hand wash only”, but they’re easy to clean because of the ultra-slick ceramic surface.
